conviction_note: Three small, mostly offsetting items. H1 should clear the company's own H1 plan (OP 17.0bn) but probably fall short of the July IFIS H1 bar (OP 19.5bn) after the August Kumamoto-quake production stoppages. Against that, the H1 FX rate of about 160 vs a 150 assumption leaves room for a FY raise, and a buyback of roughly JPY16-21bn sits in the published FY27 capital plan but has not been announced yet. p_up 53 on an abs move of 2.8 gives +0.17. The findings sum to +1.0; they are larger than the scaled number because the buyback is a low-probability, high-impact item and I cannot tell its timing.
bar: H1 (Apr-Sep) operating profit. Company H1 guide 17,000m JPY (unchanged since 2026-05-12, held 2026-07-30). IFIS H1 consensus OP 19,500m / ordinary 22,100m as of 2026-07-29, quoted on Monex/IFIS https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6923_20260730_act_20260730_150008_1 . FY IFIS consensus OP 56,150m / ordinary 62,350m (2026-10-23) vs company 55,000 / 58,000 https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6923 . The H1 street bar has a single source and is three months old, so the findings that depend on it are capped small. My estimate is H1 OP about 18.0-18.5bn: roughly +6-9% vs the company plan and about -6% vs the street.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-23: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0), source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via the sealed baseline. Margin ratio (信用倍率) 1.57, per kabutan 2026-10-26 https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6923 : mildly long, not crowded. No options, so no skew. priced_lean -0.08. Run-up -0.33% over 20 days, -2.19% over 5. The sealed spot 3,572 already includes today's -1.3% morning drop (previous close 3,620), which was a down US tape (Dow -1.24%).

findings.finding: Q1 OP was 8,760m, 51.5% of the 17,000m H1 guide (prior years' Q1 share of actual H1 OP: 46.6% in FY26, about 50% in FY25), so H1 should beat the company plan. It is less clear H1 reaches the July IFIS bar of 19,500m, which needs a 10.7bn Q2 against 9.86bn last year: the late-July 2026 Kumamoto earthquake stopped Japanese auto lines in August (Honda Japan production -32.3%, Honda China -71.7%), partly offset by Honda North America (+19.0% Jul, +8.2% Aug) and a Q2 USD/JPY around 159 vs about 147 a year earlier.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-30: OP beat IFIS by 6% and the guide was held, stock -3.78% (D-1 close to D+1 close). H1 2024-10-28: guide held, -0.50%. H1 2023-10-31: big beat on the H1 plan plus raises, +13.4%. Computed from the Yahoo daily bars https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6923.T?range=3y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Part of it is priced. The Honda and industry production data were published on 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-19, and the stock has slipped from 3,652 (10-19) to 3,572. Had the market fully marked H1 below the street, the IFIS FY ordinary consensus would have come down. It stayed at 62,350 for four weeks (kabuyoho, 10-23), so the street number has not absorbed the August stoppages.
findings.independence: Honda's monthly data, reported by LOGISTICS TODAY https://www.logi-today.com/1005505 (2026-09-30) and https://www.logi-today.com/993639 (2026-08-31), and the industry quake attribution from MONOist https://monoist.itmedia.co.jp/mn/articles/2610/19/news020.html (2026-10-19). These are separate sources from the company document.

findings.finding: The FY27 plan assumes USD/JPY 150 with a sensitivity of about +3億 OP per yen per year. Q1 averaged 160.54, Jul-Sep averaged about 159, and spot is about 157, so FX alone gives the company room to raise FY OP by roughly 2-2.5bn (to about 57-57.5bn, above the 56.15bn street) at this print, if Japan and China do not consume it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2025-10-31: FY OP raised 41.2bn to 45.0bn plus a dividend raise, +2.33%. FY24 and FY25 plans were held all year with no reaction-moving revision. The company missed its own FY plan in FY25 (490 vs 500) and in FY26 (426 vs 450), per the kabuyoho revision history https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=6923 , so a hold, which is the base case, is not a surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: The street FY OP (56.15bn) sits only 2% above the plan even though H1 FX ran 10 yen weaker than assumed. If a FX-driven raise were priced, consensus would be nearer 57-58bn. Against this, the company's record of missing its own plans is a reason the street holds back.
findings.independence: USD/JPY monthly averages from Yahoo https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=6mo&interval=1d ; the Q1 FX table in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730503602.pdf (the same company as the source, different document).

findings.finding: The FY27 capital-allocation page of the 2026-05-22 mid-term plan earmarks 300-350億 for dividends plus buybacks ('自己株式取得 継続的かつ機動的に実施'). The 111-yen dividend on about 126m shares is about 140億, which implies roughly 160-210億 (about 3.6-4.7% of the 4,500億 market cap) of buyback. None had been announced as of 2026-10-26 morning: the kabutan disclosure list from April to October shows only treasury-stock disposals for compensation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-06-10: an 800億 buyback announced alongside a guide cut, +2.56% (D-1 to D+1). 2026-05-12: FY results with a dividend raise and the +29% OP guide, +12.87%. Earlier buybacks were announced at varied times (100億 in Feb 2023, per kabutan https://s.kabutan.jp/news/n202302040195/ ), so the H1 print is a possible date, not a fixed one.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan is public, so the existence of a buyback is partly priced. Its timing is not. Probability-weighted at about 25-30% for today, it is worth roughly +3-4% if it lands and near 0 if it does not. The balance sheet (equity ratio 49.4% vs a 50% target after the 770億 Iwasaki deal, planned FCF -670億) argues against an early announcement, which is why the probability is low.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible. FX gives roughly +2bn of room, the quake and China take some back, and the company has missed its own plan two years running; a hold is the base case. Returns: interim dividend of 55 already guided; a buyback of roughly 160-210億 is in the FY27 plan and not yet announced, so it could come today (about 25-30%). New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP 51.5% of the H1 plan vs 46.6-50% history, so a beat on the company plan is likely and a shortfall vs the July street H1 is likely.

baseline_tension: Positioning is flat (no disclosed shorts, margin ratio 1.57, run-up -0.3%), so the findings neither agree with nor fight a lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is an unannounced buyback from the FY27 capital plan, plus an FX-driven FY raise; I looked for both and filed both. The one negative (H1 short of the stale street bar) rests on public production data and is sized small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public series): the reported-quarter negative rests on Honda production data published 09-29 and 10-19 and on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the Q1 deck, so I cut that finding from -0.5 to -0.3. p_up stays at 53 because that negative carried little weight in it.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives): nothing changed. The draft already had one negative and two positives, and I had already searched for the strongest positive (buyback, FY raise).
